text: 3-year-old child. The parents report that the child appears unwell and has been breathing rapidly. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Congestive Heart Failure (likely due to Congenital Heart Disease).

I have noted your age and the absence of fever or respiratory infection symptoms. Given the rapid breathing, leg swelling, and enlarged liver in a previously healthy 3-year-old, this strongly suggests fluid overload from a heart problem. I will now request your echocardiogram and complete blood count results to confirm the heart structure and function. REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram, CBC. REQUEST IMAGES.
